AVELIONS 3 - CRIMSON WARS
Demo version
Latest version : 1.26
​
+STORY+
In the year 779 MA, a hundred knights were chosen by the Epsylian Council for a dangerous mission. Led by an Aelther Warlord codenamed "Neptune," the mission aimed to occupy a camp of the Looset Empire, a significant threat to the southern territories controlled by the Kingdoms Alliance.
It is widely believed that there was only one survivor from this raid—Neptune, who betrayed the others for personal gain. Alcein, one of the knights sent by the Council under Neptune's command, witnessed this betrayal firsthand. His faith shattered, he soon found himself wandering between the worlds of the living and the dead.
Revived by a demon and made more powerful with three other souls living in his body, Alcein returns in a glorious blaze, slaying thousands, and claiming a title in his own right. However, the demon that revived Alcein made a contract with him and expects to be paid when the contract is up.
Will Alcein's thirst for vengeance spark another war? Is there any way he can find peace with himself before his contract is due?
+CHARACTERS+
Spoiler
Alcein Fraido
+++ Title : Blue Phoenix
+++ Class : Lancer
+++ Age : 19 years old
+++ Personality : Sociable and easy going
Alcein is a young Elite Knight who died and came back to life with demonic power to end the war in Death Valley. This event earned him both reputation and nobility. Lumina, the First Demoness of the Judgement Gate, granted him a second chance at life through the Black Contract, placing four "full hatred" souls into Alcein's dead body.
Due to this demonic contract, Alcein and the other three souls are now one. He can morph between the souls, each with its own unique abilities. Although Alcein is the weakest among them, he gains more fame in battle due to his determination and leadership.
Spoiler
Einhazar Lizecsou
+++ Title : Black Dragon
+++ Class : Knight
+++ Age : approximately 38 to 40 years old,
+++ Personality : Vicious, a loner
Einhazar is the opposite and absolute alter ego of Alcein. Once a dead veteran assassin from the Nouma Empire, his soul wandered around the Judgement Gate. During the Black Contract process, he managed to spiritually invade Alcein's body, allowing him to share his personality with Alcein and manifest only when Alcein lets him out.
Einhazar is a cold and heartless individual, highly skilled in assassination. He has set himself a mission to confront all Aelther Warlords on the continent and find the one who killed him in the Tower of Rebirth several years ago.
Balcard Goram
+++ Title : Stone Golem
+++ Class : Axelord
+++ Age : 24 years old
+++ Personality : Rude and primitive
Balcard is the third soul residing in Alcein's body. His incredible physical strength is evident when he severely injures an orc with a single strike. He also has more energy and greater endurance compared to the other three souls.
Before his death, Balcard was a barbarian who protected the Dark Dragon Temple. He is extremely gullible, much like a child, and often overconfident in his abilities. Alongside the other souls, he holds a grudge against the Aelther Warlords.
Feior Yuai
+++ Title : Elven Prince
+++ Class : Archer
+++ Age : 21 years old
+++ Personality : Holier-than-God attitude
Feior hails from the renowned Yuai Family, a famous bloodline in Elven Archery. Not only is he skilled with a bow, but he also has a notable charm with women. An intellectual, Feior prefers to resolve matters with his mind rather than brute force.
Feior enjoys the finer things in life and is known for his politeness to everyone. He is the last soul to empower Alcein, completing the transformation into the Soul Fusion Knight under the Black Contract.
Auvrelyn deiz Selishandrei
+++ Title : Red Wyvern
+++ Class : Champion
+++ Age : 25 years old
+++ Personality : Calm, trusted leader
Auvrelyn is one of the strongest knights in the Arsei Kingdom. She has mastered the ancient swordsmanship of the Seven Swords and was nearly undefeated in the last Phoenix Ordeal Tournament.
Despite being a woman, Auvrelyn mentors hundreds of Arsei Elite Knights. She is known for her firmness and strict discipline in carrying out her duties. Several witnesses claim that Auvrelyn is the only person to have ever killed a dragon with her bare hands.
Oswaldur
+++ Title : -
+++ Class : Ultimate Warlord
+++ Age : 58 years old,
+++ Personality : Honorable, man of virtue
Oswaldur is a noble knight and the second in command of House Dalradvent. He confronts Alcein every time an Aelther Warlord is attacked.
The two engage in a deadly fight, but Oswaldur ultimately defeats Alcein and spares his life. He warns Alcein that his actions could bring chaos to the Kingdoms Alliance and potentially trigger another war, the second Crimson War.
Lucia Ausrinne
+++ Title : The Light
+++ Class : Fallen Valkyrie
+++ Age : Unknown
+++ Personality : ???
Lucia is the originator of the mythical entity known as Lumina, the spirit of the fallen Fairy who caused the end of the First Human Race thousands of years ago. Now residing in the Juheimhen Dimension as the First Demoness of the Judgement Gate, she is responsible for collecting human souls and sending them to Hell. Lucia cannot enter the Sheidh/Sheido World without a "perfect" vessel to serve as her mortal body.
PLANNED FEATURES
8–10 Hours of Gameplay
Action Battle System:
Features XAS ABS (Action System)
4 Playable "Soul Shift" Characters:
Each with unique "Dungeon Skills"
13 Sub-Classes:
Choose from melee, magic, or hybrid classes
Skills Crafting:
Collect Magic Stones to create your own skills
Battle of Medallions Mini Game:
Challenge NPCs with your collected Monster Medallions
Upgrade Weapons and Armor:
Refine and enhance them!

posts.author: cradth
posts.body:
Hello!
I’ve just updated the download link for the game. I hope you’re not too disappointed
with the writing in this demo; I mainly focused on polishing the gameplay, much like
with my previous demos. Lately, I’ve been deeply involved in two new projects, which
has made it challenging to find time for the older titles.
It might sound a bit silly, but each of these older projects is essentially a remake of
RPG Maker VX or other engine projects, featuring simpler graphics and shorter playtime.
I’ve been recreating them in RPG Maker VX Ace or MV, but then I end up going on hiatus
and putting them on hold repeatedly.
